name: convention-reader
description: Reads and summarizes project conventions from standard config files (CLAUDE.md, tsconfig.json, .eslintrc, package.json, etc.). Deterministic — no LLM needed.

inputs.name: Project Path
inputs.description: Path to the project root directory to analyze

outputs.name: Conventions
outputs.description: Structured convention data with sections for each found config file

outputs.name: Files Found
outputs.description: List of convention files found in the project

outputs.name: Summary
outputs.description: Brief text summary of conventions for LLM context window
